Title: Jane Mugo's Journey from AKU to Global Healthcare Leader
NewsSummary: The two-time alumna is committed to addressing critical health challenges
NewsContent:
​

For Jane Njeri Mugo, the completion of her Master of Science in Advanced Practice Nursing (MSc APN) from Aga Khan University's School of Nursing and Midwifery, East Africa (SONAM EA) is more than just an academic milestone. It is the culmination of a journey shaped by dedication, hard work, and a deep connection with an institution that has influenced both her personal and professional life.

Having first earned her Bachelor of Science in Nursing from AKU, Jane now thrives as a Nurse Case Manager, Senior Analyst at Cigna Healthcare, collaborating with professionals globally. “The education and training I received at AKU gave me the tools I needed to excel in the global healthcare arena," she says. “AKU SONAM has always been a center of excellence, preparing nurses to take on leadership roles and work anywhere in the world."

As a two-time scholarship beneficiary, Jane knows all too well the value of financial aid. “The scholarship made a world of difference," she reflects. “It was a huge support that enabled me to concentrate on my studies without worrying about fees."

SONAM EA's rigorous curriculum, emphasizing clinical practice, education, research, and leadership, deeply resonated with her. "AKU's approach to nursing education is comprehensive," she explains. "The programme integrates theoretical knowledge with practical, hands-on experience, which helped me gain the confidence and skills I needed to succeed in my career."

Jane's commitment to improving patient outcomes is evident in her master's research, focusing on diabetes management in Kenya. "My goal is always to see measurable results, whether that's improving blood glucose levels or helping patients make healthier lifestyle choices," she emphasizes.

Despite her impressive achievements, Jane says mentorship played a crucial role in her success. "Every student is paired with a mentor who guides you both academically and personally. This mentorship, coupled with the strong sense of community at AKU, creates an environment where you can truly thrive."

Looking ahead, Jane aims to further her education with a PhD. "Nursing is a diverse and evolving field," she advises aspiring nurses. "Take the time to set clear goals, work hard, and aim for excellence. AKU equips its students with the necessary tools to succeed in any nursing path."

As she looks forward to Convocation, Jane is filled with pride and gratitude. “This is a proud and unforgettable moment. I am so thankful to God, my family, and AKU for helping me reach this point in my journey."
